scope.excluded: Ignored build outputs, caches, local dependencies, Git internals and private experiment originals are not project source-review inputs. Private originals were preserved.

method.core: The prior 216-file core review is retained as a historical snapshot. New implementation changes and their tests were reviewed in this round; final public file hashes are recorded here.
method.manual: Complete implementation/test/script/CI reads and complete three-language guide reads; research notes and examples were reviewed against current behavior.
method.profiles: All 307 YAML files were fully parsed, catalog constraints and derived throughput checked, and generated inventory and website statistics compared. Vendor specifications were not independently re-researched for every model.
method.evidence: All 45 evidence/manifest files, including 16 gzip archives, were parsed in full and checked structurally. Embedded logs were not manually read line by line. Original embedded digests remain original provenance, not seals of redacted public copies.
method.website: Full HTML parse; rendered copy and inline JavaScript read; CSS lines 1–550 read; ID/anchor/catalog and JavaScript syntax checked
method.images: All three documentation screenshots were visually inspected; device identities shown are synthetic demonstration data.
method.limits: Review coverage does not mean every possible branch or hardware/software combination was executed. Real GPU accuracy measurements were not performed in this cleanup.

fixes: Use catalog SM counts and the selected device for FakeCUDA BF16 capability checks; unify device-property query validation.
Use the same existing native library filename resolution for directory checks, initialization and preload environment construction.
Reuse structured_io for validation manifests, enabling .json.gz and removing the duplicated parser.
Support Python 3.10 in the catalog updater and absolute virtual-environment paths in the Linux management script.
Keep the real hybrid visibility probe baseline independent of FakeGPU environment preparation.
Correct terminal checkpoint test expectations and cover interval-aligned terminal steps.
Correct preflight stage-label documentation and CLI help in all three languages; align website installation and Linux compiler requirements.
Use TARGET_GPU_PROFILE for the physical serving calibration example and align catalog timing requirements with current throughput lookup.

Redact 284 overlooked hardware UUID fields and 30 host references across nine public files, preserve the prior bytes privately and retain embedded original digest semantics; extend the existing release privacy check.
evidence_review_limit: 26 existing embedded review_text snippets are not strict standalone JSON (19 repeated redacted path keys and 7 traceback escaping cases). Outer containers are valid; these snippets remain human review text, not replayable original calibration inputs.

skip_reasons: 1 test applies only to CPU-only PyTorch builds

ptx_sass.compiler_limit: nvcc 12.4 does not support these targets

privacy.original_experiment_digests: preserved; not asserted to match redacted public payloads

execution_limits: No physical CUDA device measurements were run.
macOS branches were reviewed and their script parameters checked; this session executed Linux builds.
